# AgroVision v2 results (auto-generated by ml/report.py)

## Dataset

Leaf corpus: **188,146 images, 223 classes, 38 crops**, merged from 38 public sources; split train/val/test = 134089/26703/27354. Pest corpus (IP102): **71,965 images, 102 species** (official split). Stratified by class, grouped by near-duplicate cluster (256-bit dHash, Hamming <= 10, within source+class) and leaf id; seed 42.

| Kind | Classes | Images |
|---|---|---|
| abiotic | 3 | 697 |
| deficiency | 26 | 7,116 |
| disease | 127 | 114,319 |
| healthy | 36 | 37,997 |
| other | 2 | 7,997 |
| pest | 29 | 20,020 |
